name: [REPO] Improve Platform Processes
description: Evidence-driven improvement of generic platform processes in corekit/config/processes/ and the process authoring standard. Upstream-safe only — operator-specific processes use p-improve-work-layer-local.

steps.title: Measure process coverage
steps.description: Using work-management, run work-log-read --hours 72 to get recent mission trees. For each M-envelope, check if it used follow_process (has processRef) or ad-hoc checkpoint_plan. Calculate coverage percentage. Group ad-hoc missions by similarity. Identify top 3 candidates for processification (recurring patterns that are GENERIC — not operator-specific workflows).
steps.accept_criteria: Coverage percentage. Top 3 generic candidates with frequency and representative mission IDs.

steps.title: Create or improve platform processes
steps.description: Create new generic processes from successful mission patterns. Improve existing processes with high step-failure rates. Processes must be generic — no operator project IDs, no operator-specific workflows. Steps must be specific.
steps.accept_criteria: Processes created/updated with specific step instructions. No operator values.

steps.title: Land via repo-improvement skill
steps.description: Land the change per the repo-improvement skill: contamination scan on the new/updated process files, branch, PR to main.
